text:
josh_sales: Hey team — large payments customer just surfaced a 7-year key retention requirement. They want options: Redwood to hold an escrowed copy, or we accept they manage keys but need SLA for unwrap during legal holds. Also pricing impact if Redwood stores wrapped backups. Thoughts?

kevin_sre: short: we cannot hold plaintext. We can support BYOK (customer KMS) and route unwraps to their KMS. Dedicated/Private deployments can have an SLA for unwrap if routing is within our infra. Hosted is messy because unwrap path crosses external KMS. :warning:

maya_eng: technical nuance — we can store wrapped key blobs (never unwrapped by us) as a backup. That means we store ciphertext produced by their KMS (e.g., `Encrypt(key_material)`), and only the customer can unwrap. Operationally doable but requires strict access controls and audit.

sara_legal: legal perspective: if Redwood acts as escrowee for wrapped blobs, contract needs PoA, limited-use clauses, and indemnity for forced disclosure requests. We should never agree to escrow plaintext. Also request for retention period is OK if customer explicitly owns keys and controls rotation.

josh_sales: customer will ask if Redwood can be the escrow holder for an enterprise plan and what the price uplift looks like. Can we give a placeholder?

li_prod: product: managed wrapped backup = feature flag + audit logs + role separation + retention lifecycle API. We should mark it as enterprise add-on and require SOC/PCI review. Pricing: base + yearly compliance fee + storage/ops surcharge.

kevin_sre: ops checklist — if we implement this: (1) k8s-secrets? no. Use an encrypted object store with HSM-backed encryption at rest, separate access policy, and nobody in ops can decrypt. (2) Access approval workflow for retrievals. (3) Regular attestation logs.

compliance_bot: reminder: run `/new-compliance-review managed-wrapped-backup <customer-name> <scope:retention+retrieval>` before including pricing in SOW.

maya_eng: Integration questions to ask customer now: KMS vendor (AWS KMS / CloudHSM / Azure Key Vault / Thales), endpoints, expected unwrap QPS, rotation cadence, whether they will provide wrapped blobs in a defined format (e.g., CMS/PKCS#7 or raw ciphertext blob). Also ask for an example wrapped blob for schema validation.

sara_legal: I'll draft clause snippets: (a) "Customer retains sole ownership of keys"; (b) "Redwood may store wrapped key blobs only; Redwood will not possess plaintext KEKs"; (c) retrieval requires formal request + customer authorization + third-party escrow process if applicable.

josh_sales: If we propose managed wrapped backup, customer may want rollback/restore testing. Can we require a rotation dry-run and acceptance test pre-go-live?

li_prod: Yes — require DRY-RUN rotation test in staging (we'll provide test plan). Add to SOW as acceptance criteria.

kevin_sre: SLA callout: "Availability of unwrap operations routed to customer KMS is subject to customer KMS uptime; Redwood's Dedicated/Private deployments will provide best-effort routing and will include an SLA for internal availability but exclude customer KMS outages." We'll add a carveout clause for maintenance windows and legal holds that require external cooperation.

josh_sales: Next steps I'm taking: (1) propose an initial response to customer clarifying we won't store plaintext, we can offer wrapped-only managed backup as an enterprise add-on subject to compliance review, and SLA nuances; (2) ask for KMS vendor, endpoints, QPS, rotation cadence, and sample wrapped blob; (3) loop legal & compliance.

maya_eng: I'll prepare a minimal integration checklist and test cases: `wrap/unwrap smoke`, `rotation dry-run`, `audit log verification`, `retrieval drill`.

kevin_sre: I'll draft an ops appendix: storage design, access controls, retrieval runbook, monitoring signals (unwrap latencies, error rates), and estimated RTO for retrievals when customer provides authorization.

compliance_bot: scheduled task: please file SOC/PCI review ticket within 24h if you plan to quote.

josh_sales: Scheduling a 30m scoping call with customer tomorrow at 9am PT to walk options. I'll include draft contract snippets and a placeholder line item: "Managed wrapped key backup (wrapped-only) — custom quote; requires compliance review."

sara_legal: I'll circulate clause drafts in the channel after the call.

josh_sales: thanks everyone. Will post meeting notes and the customer's answers to the KMS questions here after the call. :thumbsup:
